name: course-crew
description: A full-pipeline production crew for WorkBuddy course recording: script, storyboard, voiceover, animation and final video assembly.

displayDescription.en: A full-pipeline crew for WorkBuddy course recording, covering script, storyboard, voiceover, animation and final editing into publish-ready videos.
displayDescription.zh: WorkBuddy 课程录制全流程制片团，覆盖逐字稿、分镜、配音、音效、动画与成片合成。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我录一节 WorkBuddy 课程：先写逐字稿和分镜，再配音，然后做动画，最后合成成片。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me produce a WorkBuddy course: write the script and storyboard, then voiceover, then animation, and finally assemble the video.

quickPrompts.en: Help me produce a WorkBuddy course: write the script and storyboard, then voiceover, then animation, and finally assemble the video.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我录一节 WorkBuddy 课程：先写逐字稿和分镜，再配音，然后做动画，最后合成成片。

quickPrompts.en: Polish this voiceover script to sound natural and generate a TTS-ready version.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这段口播稿优化成口语化、适合配音的版本，并生成 TTS 朗读稿。

quickPrompts.en: Create concept animations with Remotion based on this storyboard and assemble a synced video.
